title: Keycloak: MariaDB Connector/J is used to connect applications developed in Java to MariaDB and MySQL databases…
description: A security vulnerability has been identified in the Keycloak package related to its use of MariaDB Connector/J, which connects Java applications to MariaDB and MySQL databases. The vulnerability affects versions of Keycloak prior to 26.7.5-r3. It has a CVSS 3.1 base score of 5.9, indicating a medium severity level. The vulnerability does not impact confidentiality or integrity but affects availability, with a high attack complexity and no privileges or user interaction required. A fix is available in version 26.7.5-r3.
